question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Gorge
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gorge"** means a deep narrow valley with steep sides, often with a stream running through it. (घाटी)

 
 
• **Example:** The hikers marveled at the beauty of the gorge, with its high cliffs and flowing river below.
 
 
 
• The correct synonym is **"Canyon"**, which also refers to a deep ravine, typically one with a river flowing through it. (गहरी घाटी)
 
 
• **Example:** The Grand Canyon in the United States is one of the most famous canyons in the world.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct synonym of **'Gorge'** is **'Canyon'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Yacht** (नौका): A medium-sized sailing boat, often used for racing or pleasure trips.

 
 
• **Example:** The family rented a yacht for their vacation on the sea.
 
 
 
• **Storm** (तूफ़ान): A violent disturbance in the atmosphere, often with strong winds and heavy rain.
 
 
• **Example:** The storm caused widespread damage across the coastal towns.
 
 
 
• **Aside** (एक ओर): To one side; out of the way.
 
 
• **Example:** She pushed the books aside to make space for her laptop.
